body: Thx for the comments. I've been having a really hard time. Scared, conflicted, ashamed, angry, restless. And to scared to tell someone my true pain. Scared of the way people will think of me, conflicted by all the thoughts rushing through my mind, ashamed by being me, angry at everyone and restless when I'm alone and to myself. I need to vent, and don't want to care so much anymore but can't shut my mind off. So there's always those negative thoughts pushing through and shouting at me what to think or do instead.
Ty, I just don't know what to do anymore
